settings_form_error_type: This value isn't the right kind. Enter a new one, or reset it.
settings_form_error_socket_addr: Enter an address and a port, like 0.0.0.0:8090 or [::]:8090.
settings_form_error_url: Enter a web address that starts with http:// or https://.
settings_form_error_host: Enter a host name or an IP address, like nas.local or 192.168.1.5.
settings_form_error_needs_confirmation: This change needs a confirmation this screen can't show, so nothing was saved. Make it from its own Settings screen.
settings_form_error_schema: This screen and Lodestar don't agree about a setting, so nothing was saved. Reload the page, then try again.
settings_form_error_server: Lodestar couldn't save the change. Your changes are kept; try again.
settings_form_offline: Couldn't reach Lodestar. Your changes are kept.
settings_form_note_locked: Your change was dropped: this setting can no longer be changed in the app.
settings_form_note_locked_env: Your change was dropped: {variable} now sets this setting.
settings_form_announce_saved_restart: Saved. Some changes apply after a restart.
settings_form_announce_undo_stale: Undo isn't possible any more: these settings were changed since. The current values are shown.
settings_form_announce_merged: These settings were changed elsewhere. Your changes are kept; review them and save again.
settings_form_announce_conflicts: Some settings were changed elsewhere. Choose which value to keep, then save again.
settings_form_announce_removed: Settings that no longer exist were left out of your changes: {count}.
settings_form_env_help: To change it, edit the variable in the container template or the environment, then restart Lodestar.
settings_form_copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it instead.
settings_form_pending_reset: Goes back to the default when you save.
settings_form_secret_remove_body: Lodestar forgets the saved value at once. This can't be undone: to use it again, you'll need to enter it again.
settings_form_json_invalid: This isn't valid JSON yet. Check the brackets, commas and quotes.
settings_form_discard_body: Your changes on this screen are lost. The saved settings stay as they are.
settings_form_disruptive_fields: This changes {fields}, which interrupts what Lodestar is doing.
settings_form_disruptive_url: Lodestar will be at {url} after a restart.
settings_form_disruptive_generic: Crawling or search may stop until Lodestar restarts.
settings_form_leave_body: Changes on this screen aren't saved yet ({count}).
settings_form_summary_title: Nothing was saved. Fix these first:
settings_form_draft_title: You have unsaved changes from earlier
settings_form_draft_body: Restore them to keep editing, or discard them.
settings_form_draft_dropped: Restore them to keep editing, or discard them. Some no longer apply and are left out: {count}.
settings_form_busy: Lodestar is busy. Your changes are kept; try again in {seconds} seconds.
settings_form_load_error: Couldn't load these settings. Check that Lodestar is running, then retry.
settings_general_help: Where Lodestar keeps its data, plus backup and reset.
settings_network_help: Where the web page listens and how Lodestar joins the DHT.
settings_crawler_help: How hard Lodestar crawls and how it fetches torrent details.
settings_transport_help: Which connections Lodestar uses to fetch torrent details from peers.
settings_storage_help: How Lodestar keeps what it finds on disk.
settings_search_help: Whether the search index is kept up to date, and how much memory it may use.
settings_content_help: Whether adult content is shown, and where it may appear.
settings_preferences_help: How the interface looks and behaves for your account.
settings_logging_help: What Lodestar records about itself, and where it writes it.
settings_general_data_dir_help: Holds the database, the search index and the DHT state. Set it in config.toml or with LODESTAR_DATA_DIR; it can’t be moved while Lodestar runs.
settings_network_http_bind_help: The address and port where this page and the API listen, like 0.0.0.0:8090. After a restart you sign in at the new address.
settings_network_secure_cookies_help: Marks the sign-in cookie as HTTPS-only. Set it in config.toml or with LODESTAR_SECURE_COOKIES when a reverse proxy serves Lodestar over HTTPS.
settings_network_dht_port_help: The UDP port the DHT listens on. Forward it on your router so other nodes can reach you.
settings_network_dht_enabled_help: Turn it off to stop finding new torrents. Everything already found stays searchable.
settings_crawler_intensity_help: How hard the crawler works. Higher finds more torrents and uses more CPU, memory and bandwidth.
settings_crawler_encryption_help: Whether fetches use encrypted peer connections. Requiring it hides traffic from your provider but reaches fewer peers.
settings_crawler_max_sockets_help: How many torrents are fetched at once. Automatic follows the intensity.
settings_crawler_timeout_secs_help: How long to wait for a peer before giving up on a torrent.
settings_crawler_max_metadata_mib_help: Torrents with larger details than this are skipped.
settings_crawler_paused_help: Stops finding and fetching torrents. Lodestar still answers other DHT nodes.
settings_transport_utp_help: Fetch torrent details over uTP as well as TCP. It reaches more peers behind home routers.
settings_transport_fallback_to_tcp_help: When a uTP connection fails, try the same peer over TCP.
settings_storage_mmap_mib_help: Memory the database may map per connection to read faster. 0 turns it off.
settings_storage_archive_raw_help: Keeps each torrent’s details (without the piece hashes) so they can be re-read later. It uses more disk.
settings_search_enabled_label: Keep the search index up to date
settings_search_enabled_help: Turn it off and new torrents stop appearing in search until you turn it on again.
settings_search_heap_mib_help: Memory the index writer may use. More makes indexing faster.
settings_content_show_adult_help: Shows adult torrents in search results and counts. Off by default; turning it on asks you to confirm you are 18 or older.
settings_content_torznab_adult_help: Includes adult results in Torznab feeds. Not used yet.
settings_content_stremio_adult_help: Includes adult results in the Stremio add-on. Not used yet.
settings_content_export_adult_help: Includes adult torrents when you export the index.
settings_preferences_theme_help: The colour family used in light mode, and in dark mode unless you pick another.
settings_preferences_theme_dark_help: A different colour family for dark mode. Leave it empty to use the theme above.
settings_preferences_mode_help: Light, dark, or following your device.
settings_preferences_density_help: How much space each search result takes.
settings_preferences_motion_help: Follow your device’s reduced-motion setting, or always reduce or always play animation.
settings_preferences_illustrations_help: Shows pictures in empty screens and in setup.
settings_preferences_shortcuts_help: Keys like j, k and / that work when you are not typing. Turn them off if they get in the way.
settings_preferences_shortcut_keys_help: Keys you have changed. Anything not listed keeps its default key.
settings_preferences_language_help: The language of the interface, like en or zh-CN. Leave it empty to follow your browser.
settings_preferences_time_zone_help: A time zone like Europe/Berlin, used for dates and times. Leave it empty to follow your browser.
settings_preferences_first_day_of_week_h: Where calendars start. Automatic follows your language.
settings_logging_verbosity_help: How much Lodestar logs. More detail helps when something is wrong but fills the logs faster.
settings_logging_events_help: Events you turned on or off against the detail level. Required events can’t be turned off.
settings_logging_temporary_verbosity_hel: A higher detail level that applies only until the time below.
settings_logging_temporary_until_help: When the temporary detail level switches off by itself.
settings_logging_components_help: Different detail levels for single parts of Lodestar, like the DHT.
settings_logging_libraries_help: A tracing rule for the libraries Lodestar uses. Leave it as is unless a developer asks.
settings_logging_data_help: Whether logs may contain torrent hashes or full names. Private keeps them out.
settings_logging_data_until_help: When identifying data stops being logged. Off keeps it out; “until turned off” keeps it in until you say so.
settings_logging_kinds_help: Kinds of identifying data you switched on or off, each with its own end time.
settings_logging_peer_activity_until_hel: When logging individual peer activity switches off by itself.
settings_logging_change_details_until_he: When logging the details of filter changes switches off by itself.
settings_logging_console_format_help: Plain text for people, or JSON for tools that read the output.
settings_logging_console_detail_help: What the console may show. “Same as the file” can include identifying data, which docker logs keeps and Lodestar can’t delete.
settings_logging_console_level_help: The lowest level the console shows.
settings_logging_file_enabled_help: Writes lodestar.jsonl in the log folder, so you can read it after a restart.
settings_logging_file_folder_help: Where log files are written. Applies after a restart.
settings_logging_file_level_help: The lowest level written to the file.
settings_logging_file_size_mib_help: A log file starts a new file when it reaches this size.
settings_logging_file_count_help: How many older, compressed log files are kept.
settings_logging_file_max_age_days_help: Older log files are deleted after this long.
settings_logging_file_total_mib_help: The log folder never grows past this; the oldest files go first.
settings_logging_event_log_errors_help: Writes errors to the Windows Event Log. Only applies when Lodestar runs as a Windows service.
settings_ui_overview_purpose: Is anything wrong, and what did you change?
settings_ui_screen_crawler_purpose: How hard Lodestar crawls and how it fetches torrent details.
settings_ui_screen_network_purpose: Where the web page listens and how Lodestar joins the DHT.
settings_ui_screen_storage_purpose: How Lodestar keeps what it finds on disk.
settings_ui_screen_search_purpose: Whether the search index is kept up to date, and how much memory it may use.
settings_ui_screen_general_purpose: Where Lodestar keeps its data, plus backup and reset.
settings_ui_nothing_changed: Nothing on this screen differs from its default.
settings_ui_index_failed: Couldn't load the settings. Check that Lodestar is running, then try again.
settings_ui_screen_failed: Couldn't load this screen. Try again.
settings_ui_lockout_url: After a restart, Lodestar is at {url}.
settings_ui_lockout_url_unknown: After a restart, Lodestar listens on the new address.
settings_ui_lockout_confirm: Sign in there and confirm within 5 minutes. If nobody does, Lodestar goes back to the current address by itself.
settings_ui_dht_port: After a restart the DHT listens on the new port. Forward it on your router, or other nodes can't reach you.
settings_ui_dht_toggle: After a restart Lodestar stops finding new torrents. What it already found stays searchable.
settings_ui_reach_dht_off: The DHT is off, so there is nothing to reach.
settings_ui_reach_bootstrapping: Lodestar is still joining the DHT.
settings_ui_reach_unsolicited_queries: Other nodes are reaching the DHT port on their own.
settings_ui_reach_few_sources: Only a few networks have reached the DHT port so far. Check again later.
settings_ui_reach_none: No other node has reached the DHT port. Forward the UDP port on your router, then check again.
settings_ui_reach_wait: Wait a moment before checking again.
